correctness.rationale: The signed-word characterization follows exactly from the two-cycle and indegree/outdegree constraints on a path. Reversal-fixed words have central zeros and biject with shorter path faces. Every nonempty fixed face has even size 2p and chain permutation sign (-1)^p; including the augmented empty face yields reduced Lefschetz number equal to the shorter complex reduced Euler characteristic. The 2026 published all-length sphere theorem fixes the unique integral Betti degree, so Hopf trace determines its sign without extrapolating from finite calculations; averaging after barycentric subdivision yields the rational orbit homology. Verified scripts enumerate all faces through n=12 for trace and mod-two boundary ranks through n=9.
